edgeTaxonomy.progression: Linear forward transition to the next workflow stage
edgeTaxonomy.conditional: Forward transition gated on a specific condition or mode
edgeTaxonomy.alternative: Branching choice among mutually applicable domain/validator skills
edgeTaxonomy.fallback: Recovery or troubleshooting transition when a check or asset fails
edgeTaxonomy.retry: Loop back to an earlier stage after fixing a failed gate (requires exit condition)
edgeTaxonomy.upstream_reference: Backward declaration naming the upstream skill that supplies inputs
edgeTaxonomy.boundary_delegation: Lateral boundary statement clarifying which skill owns an excluded concern
